def transform(grid):
    # Nested framed rectangles: fill each rectangle interior with the scattered marker
    # that lies outside the frames, using the frame colors as border.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # find rectangular ring components (colors with solid perimeter)
    colors=set(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,5,4,8))
    for c in colors:
        pts=[(r,col) for r in range(h) for col in range(w) if grid[r][col]==c]
        r0,r1=min(r for r,x in pts),max(r for r,x in pts); c0,c1=min(x for r,x in pts),max(x for r,x in pts)
        # identify boundary ring, fill interior alternating pattern with 5 or other isolated color
        if all(grid[r0][x]==c and grid[r1][x]==c for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[y][c0]==c and grid[y][c1]==c for y in range(r0,r1+1)):
            # count other distinct marker color outside that ring, usually 5
            marks=[v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,c,4)]
            mark=5 if 5 in marks else 3
            for r in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1): out[r][x]=mark if (r-r0+x-c0)%2==1 else 0
            # remove stray noise (other color dots outside frames)
            for r in range(h):
                for x in range(w):
                    if grid[r][x] not in (0,c,4,5): out[r][x]=0
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]; frames=[]
    framecolors={v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,4,5,8)}
    for c in framecolors:
        pts=[(r,x) for r in range(h) for x in range(w) if grid[r][x]==c]
        r0,r1=min(r for r,x in pts),max(r for r,x in pts); x0,x1=min(x for r,x in pts),max(x for r,x in pts)
        if all(grid[r0][x]==c and grid[r1][x]==c for x in range(x0,x1+1)) and all(grid[r][x0]==c and grid[r][x1]==c for r in range(r0,r1+1)):
            frames.append((c,r0,r1,x0,x1,(r1-r0-1)*(x1-x0-1)))
    seeds=[c for c in (3,4,5,6,8) if c not in framecolors and any(c in row for row in grid)]
    seeds.sort(key=lambda c:sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    frames.sort(key=lambda f:f[5])
    fillmap={f[0]:seeds[i] for i,f in enumerate(frames) if i<len(seeds)}
    for c,r0,r1,x0,x1,_ in frames:
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):

                if r in (r0,r1) or x in (x0,x1): out[r][x]=c
                elif (r-r0+x-x0)%2==0: out[r][x]=fillmap.get(c,0)
    return out
